**Analysis Trail – Project: SUPERFANCY  
Component UUID: AB1010CD

| Step | Date/Time (UTC) | Action | Tool/Method Used | Outcome |
|------|-----------------|--------|------------------|---------|

| 2 | 2026‑06‑25 10:15 | **Component Mapping** | Cross‑reference component registry | Confirmed that vulnerability belongs to component `AB1010CD` within project `SUPERFANCY`. |
| 3 | 2026‑06‑25 10:20 | **Severity Assessment** | CVSS v3.1 scoring engine | Calculated base score 7.8 (High). Attack vector: Local; Privileges required: None. |
| 4 | 2026‑06‑25 10:25 | **Root Cause Analysis** | Manual code review + dynamic fuzz testing | Identified missing bounds check on user input buffer. |
| 5 | 2026‑06‑25 10:30 | **Mitigation Strategy Development** | Design review meeting with dev & security teams | Proposed patch: add explicit bounds check (`if (len < MAX_LEN)`) and use safe copy routine (`strncpy_s`). |
| 6 | 2026‑06‑25 10:35 | **Patch Implementation** | Code commit to Git repository | Applied changes to `src/process_input.c`. Commit hash: `a1b2c3d4e5f6`. |
| 7 | 2026‑06‑25 10:40 | **Regression Testing** | Unit tests + integration tests run via Jenkins CI | All tests passed. No new failures introduced. |
| 8 | 2026‑06‑25 10:45 | **Verification of Fix** | Re‑run SCA scan | Vulnerability `ef903ac-893-f00` no longer reported. |
| 9 | 2026‑06‑25 10:50 | **Documentation Update** | Updated component documentation and vulnerability tracker | Logged resolution status: “Fixed”. Added patch notes and test coverage metrics. |
| 10 | 2026‑06‑25 10:55 | **Final Review & Sign‑off** | Security lead sign‑off | Approved fix. Vulnerability marked as resolved in the issue tracker. |

**Summary:**  
The vulnerability `ef903ac-893-f00` affecting component `AB1010CD` was identified, assessed, mitigated, and verified within a single day. All relevant stakeholders reviewed and signed off on the fix, ensuring compliance with internal security policies and external regulatory requirements.
